nodes.description: Public total token supply state variable declared in ERC20Basic; set once in the AdvancedToken constructor.
Mapping of user address to token balance in BasicToken; written by transfer/transferFrom and read by balanceOf.
Governance address used as the target contract for the external AirDrop call inside the airnow modifier; set in the constructor.
Nested allowance mapping in StandardToken; written by approve and transferFrom.
Owner address in Ownable; set to msg.sender at construction and updated by transferOwnership.
Public boolean pause flag in Pausable; toggled by pause and unpause.
Mapping of account to frozen status in PausableToken; written by freezeAccount and read by transfer/transferFrom.
Public token decimals variable used to compute the initial totalSupply.
External transfer function guarded by the airnow modifier; performs an external AirDrop call before updating balances.
Read-only function returning balances[_owner].
External allowance-based transfer guarded by airnow; performs external AirDrop call before updating balances and allowances.
Sets the allowance for a spender of msg.sender.
Read-only function returning allowed[_owner][_spender].
onlyOwner function that transfers contract ownership to newOwner.
onlyOwner function that sets paused to true.
onlyOwner function that sets paused to false.
Overrides transfer with whenNotPaused and frozen-account checks, then calls super.transfer.
Overrides transferFrom with whenNotPaused and frozen-account checks, then calls super.transferFrom.
Overrides approve with whenNotPaused, then calls super.approve.
onlyOwner function that toggles frozenAccount[target].
Constructor that mints the total supply to the deployer and stores the governance address.
Modifier that calls AirDrop(_governance).doAirdrop(sender,recipient) before the guarded function body executes.
Untrusted external call to the AirDrop interface contract at the _governance address executed prior to state updates.
Checked addition helper performing arithmetic that must be overflow-safe.
Checked subtraction helper performing arithmetic that must be underflow-safe.
Checked multiplication helper performing arithmetic that must be overflow-safe.
Checked division helper enforcing a non-zero divisor.
Caller-controlled address used for balance checks, allowance keys and as the sender argument to the external AirDrop call.
Amount parameter of BasicToken.transfer controlling balance debits and credits.
Amount parameter of StandardToken.transferFrom controlling balance and allowance updates.
Allowance amount parameter of StandardToken.approve.
New owner address parameter of Ownable.transferOwnership.
Account address parameter of PausableToken.freezeAccount.
Governance address parameter assigned to _governance in the AdvancedToken constructor.
Local variable holding the checked sum in SafeMath.add.
Local variable holding the checked difference in SafeMath.sub.
Local variable holding the checked product in SafeMath.mul.
Local variable holding the checked quotient in SafeMath.div.

edges.reason: msg.sender is read to validate and debit the caller balance inside BasicToken.transfer.
BasicToken.transfer writes updated balances to the balances mapping.
BasicToken.transfer subtracts _value using SafeMath.sub on the sender balance.
BasicToken.transfer adds _value using SafeMath.add on the recipient balance.
The _value parameter bounds the transfer amount used in BasicToken.transfer.
StandardToken.transferFrom writes updated balances to the balances mapping.
StandardToken.transferFrom decrements the allowed mapping for the caller.
StandardToken.transferFrom subtracts values using SafeMath.sub on balances and allowances.
StandardToken.transferFrom adds _value using SafeMath.add on the recipient balance.
The _value parameter drives balance and allowance updates in StandardToken.transferFrom.
StandardToken.approve writes the allowance into the allowed mapping.
The _value parameter is stored as the allowance by StandardToken.approve.
Ownable.transferOwnership overwrites the owner state variable.
The newOwner parameter becomes the new owner in Ownable.transferOwnership.
Pausable.pause sets the paused flag to true.
Pausable.unpause sets the paused flag to false.
PausableToken.freezeAccount writes frozenAccount[target].
The target parameter selects the account frozen by PausableToken.freezeAccount.
The AdvancedToken constructor sets the initial totalSupply.
The AdvancedToken constructor reads decimals to compute the total supply.
The AdvancedToken constructor assigns the governance address to _governance.
The AdvancedToken constructor credits the deployer balance in the balances mapping.
The _gov constructor parameter is stored into the _governance state variable.
The external AirDrop call target address is resolved from the _governance state variable.
BasicToken.balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
StandardToken.allowance reads the allowed mapping.
msg.sender is forwarded as the sender argument to the external call in the airnow modifier.
BasicToken.transfer applies the airnow modifier, executing the external call before its own state updates.
StandardToken.transferFrom applies the airnow modifier, executing the external call before its own state updates.
PausableToken.transfer delegates to super.transfer after pause/freeze checks.
PausableToken.transferFrom delegates to super.transferFrom after pause/freeze checks.
PausableToken.approve delegates to super.approve after the pause check.
The airnow modifier invokes the untrusted AirDrop.doAirdrop external call before the function body runs.
During the external AirDrop callback the balances mapping has not yet been updated, enabling reentrant reads/writes.
During the external AirDrop callback the allowed mapping has not yet been updated in transferFrom.
SafeMath.add stores its checked result in the local variable c.
SafeMath.sub stores its checked result in the local variable c.
SafeMath.mul stores its checked result in the local variable c.
SafeMath.div stores its checked result in the local variable c.

normalization_plan.reason: The _value parameter only exists to feed the balance math of BasicToken.transfer and carries no independent semantics.
The _value parameter is used solely within StandardToken.transferFrom for balance and allowance updates.
The _value parameter is written directly into the allowed mapping by StandardToken.approve.
The newOwner parameter is only consumed by Ownable.transferOwnership to overwrite owner.
The target parameter is only used to index frozenAccount inside PausableToken.freezeAccount.
The _gov parameter is only used to initialize _governance inside the AdvancedToken constructor.
The local c is the transient result of the SafeMath.add operation.
The local c is the transient result of the SafeMath.sub operation.
The local c is the transient result of the SafeMath.mul operation.
The local c is the transient result of the SafeMath.div operation.
